question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 to $108.0B ±2% (Aug 26, 2026), excluding China DC compute. Recent beats vs guidance: Q3FY26 +5.6%, Q4FY26 +4.8%, Q1FY27 ~+4.6%, Q2FY27 +5.7% ($91B->$96.2B); absolute beats have grown to ~$3-5B. Applying a ~4.5-6% beat gives ~$112.9-114.5B; median ~$113.1B. Sell-side consensus ~$111.4B sits below that, as usual. Thin Manifold market (M165, 4 holders) centers ~$110-114B, slightly lower. Upside escape >$116B (>7.4% beat) priced at 7%; downside below $105B requires a miss below the guide's low end, never seen recently.

- Q3 FY27 guidance: revenue $108.0B ±2% (range $105.84B-$110.16B); GM 74.0% ±50bp; GAAP opex ~$9.2B; outlook assumes NO China Data Center compute revenue (press release, Aug 26 2026).
- Pre-guide street expectation for Q3 was ~$104.2B; current sell-side consensus cited ~$111.4B (chartmill/search summary, Oct 2026).

Older guide figures are from memory, not sourced this run.
- Beat % applied to $108B: +2.5% -> $110.7B; +3.9% -> $112.2B; +4.8% -> $113.2B; +5.7% -> $114.2B. Need >+7.4% beat to exceed $116B; need a miss >2.8% below guide midpoint to fall under $105B (no such miss in the reference class).
- Upside factors: Blackwell Ultra/Rubin ramp, hyperscaler capex growth, possible China reopening (not in guide). Downside factors: CoWoS/HBM supply limits, export-rule changes, customer digestion.
- Report date: sources cite Nov 18, 2026 after close; question says expected no earlier than Nov 25, 2026. Either way it is the first report after Sep 30 2026.
